last_run: Added 'You vs the outside view' to the 'How well-calibrated are you?' card on My beliefs. Once someone has 10+ graded 'How sure' calls, it shows the score they'd have got by just saying the base rate (how often calls like theirs beat the S&P) beside their own score on the same calls, and says better / worse / about the same, only calling it when the gap is bigger than luck would explain. This is the honest version of 'compare yourself with the brain': the brain's own High/Medium/Low is 'medium' almost every time, so it had nothing to compare. Information only.
